visual_verdict: I looked at 14 images (slices at 3-5x, 6x strips). Slow sweep: the fixed lane's front-slab edge (r692) is soft and close to GT. Medium, fast and reverse: at the right slab feet (r614), the white rock and the front slab the edge still steps much like BASE. I cannot tell the fixed build from the judged build by eye; the GT glides. The small pale dashes on the right slab feet (x~1082) are the same in BASE, judged and fixed and absent in GT. The far-floe pale rectangle still pops in, for about 8 frames in the reverse sweep (k46-53) and about 57 frames in the medium sweep (k103-160), in BASE, judged and fixed alike; GT has none. No 1/3-cycle flash, and no trailing in the slices I viewed. The fix round gained a few points but does not change what the user would see.
